manifest.name: Spoiler Blocker for GTA 6
manifest.description: Hides GTA 6 spoilers across the web by checking pages against an automatically updated spoiler list.

store.name: Spoiler Blocker for GTA 6
store.summary: Hides GTA 6 spoilers on social sites, video sites, search and news. Works in your browser; the spoiler list updates itself.
description: Avoid GTA 6 story spoilers while you browse.

The extension blurs posts, videos, comments and search results that would give away the story: who dies, twists, endings, the final missions and the names that reveal them. Everything else on the page stays as it is.
- Works on YouTube, Reddit, X, Bluesky, Facebook, Instagram, Twitch, Kick, Discord, Steam, Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, Gmail, and basic support for other websites.
- Hides the whole post or comment, not just a word, so the rest of a thread stays readable.
- Hides everything from known spoiler accounts, whatever their posts say.
- You choose how much to protect: only the big moments, the main story (default), or everything.
- Blur, collapse or remove; click or hold to peek; pause it, or set a day it stops.
- Safe and strict site lists, your own words to hide, and words never to hide.
- The spoiler list updates by itself while the game's wikis fill in.
- It reads words, not meaning: a comment that tells the story in plain words, with no name or spoiler word in it, can still get through.
Private by design: pages are read only inside your browser. No account, no tracking, no analytics. The only download is the spoiler list itself.
Not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Grand Theft Auto and GTA are trademarks of Take-Two Interactive.

welcome.title: Thank you for installing Spoiler Blocker for GTA 6
welcome.intro: Spoiler Blocker hides GTA 6 spoilers on the pages you visit: Reddit, YouTube, X, search results and everywhere else. It reads pages only inside your browser, looks for matches with a list of spoilers, and hides the content when it finds one. Nothing about what you browse is sent anywhere. The extension's code is open source on GitHub.
welcome.pick: How much do you want hidden?
welcome.change: You can change this any time.
welcome.pin: Tip: pin the extension to your toolbar with the puzzle-piece icon. From there you can pause it or mark a site as safe. In private (Incognito) windows Chrome keeps extensions off until you turn on Allow in Incognito on the extension's details page.
welcome.saved: Saved. You can change this any time.
welcome.howto: Click the label on anything hidden to see it. Finished the game? Just switch it off in the popup. It reads words, not meaning: a comment that tells the story in plain words, with no name or spoiler word in it, can still get through.
welcome.launchPick: Hide every post about GTA 6 for the first days after release?
welcome.launchHelp: This catches things before the spoiler list knows them, like new features nobody has written up yet. It also hides harmless posts during that time.

post.name: Also on mixed pages (default)
post.help: Your Reddit home, YouTube home, X timeline. Any post there that mentions GTA 6 gets its pictures covered, on top of pages about GTA 6. Words stay readable, and one click shows a picture. Not when How careful is "Light: only obvious spoilers".

show.name: Show them
show.help: A GIF posted as a reply with no words of its own about the game, and with a clean description, is shown, even on a page about the game. Reaction GIFs are almost always harmless. A game clip posted as a GIF reply stays visible too. The post's own pictures, quoted posts, link cards, galleries and video are still covered.

cover.name: Cover them like other pictures (default)
cover.help: Reply GIFs that are not from a GIF library are covered like any other picture next to the name of the game. Safer, but harmless ones get covered too. A GIF from a GIF library is judged by 'Reaction GIFs from a GIF library' above, whatever this says.

show.name: Show them
show.help: A photo or picture posted as a reply with no words of its own about the game, and with a clean description, is shown, even on a page about the game. A spoiler screenshot posted as a bare reply stays visible too. The post's own pictures, quoted posts, link cards, galleries and video are still covered.

cover.name: Cover them like other pictures (default)
cover.help: Reply photos are covered like any other picture next to the name of the game. It also covers a spoiler screenshot posted as a bare reply, at the price of covering harmless photos too.

label.name: Judge them by their label (default)
label.help: A GIF from a GIF library, posted as a reply or not, is hidden when its label or title names the game (like GTA 6) or gives something away. A reply's own words about the game count too. Otherwise it shows, even next to the name of the game. A spoiler GIF with a harmless-sounding label can slip through; pick the other choice if you want no risk.

picture.name: Always cover them like pictures
picture.help: Reaction GIFs, reply GIFs from a GIF library included, are treated like any other picture, so they are covered whenever the pictures above would be. Safer, but harmless GIFs get covered too.

listStale.never: The spoiler list has not updated yet.
listStale.since: The spoiler list has not updated since {date}.

text.layoutChanged: This site seems to have changed its layout, so the general rules are used on this page.
text.cannotCheck: This page can't be checked: browsers keep their own pages off limits.
text.offOnPage: Turn off on this page only
text.pageOffDone: Turned off on this page only

sitePictures.name: Pictures on this site
sitePictures.help: Covered: pictures near the game are covered here. Shown: pictures are not covered just for being pictures; a post whose words give something away is still hidden.
sitePictures.mixed: This site has its own mix of picture settings. Pick one here, or change them in Settings.
sitePictures.blackout: While the blackout is on, a site's own picture choice counts only where it covers more than your usual one.
sitePictures.groupHelp: Same as everywhere uses your choices on the Pictures and comments tab.
sitePictures.fromGroup: Set for {group} in Settings. A choice here is for this site only.
sitePictures.groupOff: Switched off for {group}. You can turn this site back on by itself.
sitePictures.groupOffResume: Turn back on for this site
sitePictures.siteOffNo: Hide here, even when its group is switched off

groups.title: Groups of sites
groups.help: A site's own choices below beat its group. On a YouTube live page, Livestream sites beats YouTube.
groups.livestream: Livestream sites: Twitch, Kick, YouTube live pages

text.previewGone: Nothing here: the post is gone

timer.name: Hide only during a set time
timer.help: Pick when hiding starts, when it stops, or both. Leave one empty for no limit on that side.
timer.backwards: Your stop time is before your start time, so nothing will ever be hidden. Change one of them.
timer.tooEarly: That date looks wrong, so it was not saved.

text.revealConfirm: Press again to show them all

hideImages.name: Also hide spoiler pictures and video thumbnails
hideImages.help: Hides a picture when its caption or file name gives something away. A spoiler shown only inside the picture can still get through.

hideMediaPosts.name: Hide picture and video posts on pages that mention GTA 6
hideMediaPosts.help: On a page about the game, a post that is only a picture or clip, with almost no words, is hidden in case it shows a spoiler. Harmless clips go too. While "Pictures next to the name of the game" is on (the default), those pictures and clips are covered anyway, so this adds almost nothing. Needs "Also hide spoiler pictures and video thumbnails" on. Not in Casual, or when How careful is "Light: only obvious spoilers".

noEffect.hideImagesOff: Greyed out: it needs "Also hide spoiler pictures and video thumbnails" on.
noEffect.casual: Greyed out: it does nothing in Casual, or when How careful is "Light: only obvious spoilers".
noEffect.mediaNearOn: It adds almost nothing while "Pictures next to the name of the game" is on: those pictures and clips are covered anyway.

summary.title: Current settings
summary.thumbsBlackoutNote: words are not hidden, not even by the blackout
summary.mediaPageNote: Pictures in mixed feeds (like Reddit home) are not covered.
summary.differNone: Nothing: every setting is as it came.

noEffect.hideImagesOff: no effect: needs Spoiler pictures on
noEffect.casual: no effect in Casual or with How careful on Light
noEffect.mediaNearOn: adds little: mostly covered anyway by Pictures next to the name of the game

summary.blackoutOn: Blackout is ON, until you turn it off

labels.mediaNearGame: Pictures next to the game's name

text.mediaNearGame: Pictures next to the name of the game
text.reactionGifs: Reaction GIFs from a GIF library

customWords.name: My own words to hide
customWords.help: Anything you add is hidden on every page. Tip: select text on any page, right-click, and choose "Hide this on every page".
customWords.placeholder: Type a word or phrase, then press Add

spoilerAccounts.name: Hide known spoiler accounts
spoilerAccounts.help: Some channels post whole stories the day a game comes out.
spoilerAccounts.check: On YouTube and X, plus any post on any site, Reddit included, that names or links to the channel.

blockedAccounts.name: My own accounts to hide
blockedAccounts.help: Paste a link to the account. Formats: youtube.com/@name, x.com/name, reddit.com/user/name, tiktok.com/@name, instagram.com/name, twitch.tv/name, kick.com/name. Everything it posts is hidden on every site.
blockedAccounts.placeholder: Paste a link to an account, then press Add
blockedAccounts.bad: That is not an account link. Try one of: youtube.com/@name, x.com/name, reddit.com/user/name, tiktok.com/@name, instagram.com/name, twitch.tv/name, kick.com/name.

allowWords.name: Words never to hide
allowWords.help: If something you want to see keeps getting hidden, add the word here. Tip: select the word on any page, right-click, and choose "Never hide this word".
allowWords.placeholder: Type a word or phrase, then press Add
allowWords.refused: The game's name can't be allowed. Use "Never hide this account" or add the site to Safe places instead.
allowWords.refusedNotice: Right-click "Never hide this word" did not add the word you picked: the game's name can't be allowed. Use "Never hide this account" or add the site to Safe places instead.

allowAccounts.name: Accounts never to hide
allowAccounts.help: Posts from these known spoiler accounts are no longer hidden just for who posted them. Their words are still checked like anyone else's. Each one counts on its own site only. An account on "My own accounts to hide" stays hidden: take it off that list to see it again. Tip: right-click the account's name on any page and choose "Never hide this account".
allowAccounts.placeholder: Paste a link to an account, then press Add
allowAccounts.bad: That is not an account link. Try one of: youtube.com/@name, x.com/name, reddit.com/user/name, tiktok.com/@name, instagram.com/name, twitch.tv/name, kick.com/name.

hintWords.name: Words that show a post is about the game
hintWords.help: If one of these sits near a name that could mean anything, the post is hidden, like "Trevor dies at the end". Only on social and search sites. Remove a word if too much gets hidden.
hintWords.placeholder: Type a word, phrase or emoji, then press Add

allowSites.name: Safe places (nothing is ever hidden)
allowSites.help: Same as Turn off in the popup. If a place is on both lists, this one wins.
allowSites.placeholder: Paste a web address or type a site
examples: the site and every page on it
that part and everything under it

blockSites.name: Places to be extra careful
blockSites.help: Here, a post is hidden if it has any spoiler-list name you chose to hide, such as Lester or The Jewel Store Job in GTA V. A post saying only "Lester" would be hidden, even if GTA 6 is never mentioned. Good for places full of spoilers.
blockSites.placeholder: Paste a web address or type a site
examples: the site and every page on it
that part and everything under it

text.siteChoiceIntro: How much should this cover? Pick one to add it.
text.siteBadAddress: That does not look like a web address. Try something like rockstargames.com.
text.siteAlreadyThere: That one is already in the list.

categories.name: Hide by topic
categories.help: One switch for each topic below: Hide, Only when the page mentions GTA 6, or Show. "Hide" follows What to hide and the block out method. Posts about leaks and trailers have only Hide and Show, and are only controlled here, so pick "Show" if you want to see them.

protect.name: What to hide
protect.help: Pick how much of the game to keep secret. The list below shows what each choice hides.

donate.name: Thanks to the gta.wiki team
donate.help: This would not be possible without the gta.wiki team. They were not consulted, but this extension relies on them and their edits. If you find it useful, consider funding them or seeing how you can help.

updates.name: Spoiler update frequency
updates.help: How often the extension downloads the newest spoiler list. A job watches the GTA wikis and adds new names; your browser only downloads the finished list.
updates.privacyNote: The list is never shown, so updating can not spoil you.
updates.failed: The last try, {when}, did not work: {why}

failedWhy.network: the update server could not be reached.
failedWhy.invalid: the downloaded list was not valid, so the old one was kept.

result.wait: You just checked. Please wait a minute before checking again.
